title: 銅合金連續擠製
summary: 以「銅材連續擠製的入口質量與出口截面」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「將滑移造成的速度差當成材料流失」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on Feed mass and exit section in continuous copper extrusion, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of Mistaking slip-induced speed differences for material loss.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

steps.title: 單元1｜截面減縮率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Section reduction: Quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以「銅材連續擠製的入口質量與出口截面」完成定量估算並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for Feed mass and exit section in continuous copper extrusion with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「銅材連續擠製的入口質量與出口截面」的「截面減縮率」採以下合成教學值：initial=100 mm²；final=60 mm²。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 100*(initial-final)/initial；獨立基準為 40 %。把 initial 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 45.4545455 %。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Feed mass and exit section in continuous copper extrusion, use synthetic inputs for Section reduction: initial=100 mm²；final=60 mm². Check dimensions before evaluating 100*(initial-final)/initial; the independent benchmark is 40 %. Increase initial by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 45.4545455 %. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: initial增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 5.45454545 %。不能直接等同塑性應變、強度提升或材料收得。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 5.45454545 %. It is not identical to plastic strain, strength gain or material yield.
steps.failure: 將滑移造成的速度差當成材料流失；不能直接等同塑性應變、強度提升或材料收得。
steps.failureEn: Mistaking slip-induced speed differences for material loss; It is not identical to plastic strain, strength gain or material yield.
steps.check: 原值重算與 40 % 相符；10%案例與 45.4545455 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 40 % at baseline and 45.4545455 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（%）？
quiz.explanation: 按 100*(initial-final)/initial 逐項代入，結果為 40；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into 100*(initial-final)/initial gives 40; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元1｜截面減縮率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Section reduction: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「銅材連續擠製的入口質量與出口截面」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Feed mass and exit section in continuous copper extrusion with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「銅材連續擠製的入口質量與出口截面」設計「截面減縮率」的獨立驗證：在相同截面方向量測寬厚，記錄飛邊、孔洞與外加材料。 三方向幾何、進出質量及時間資料須互相一致，保留工具和試片編號。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Feed mass and exit section in continuous copper extrusion, independently verify Section reduction: Measure width and thickness in matching directions and account for flash, voids and added material. Three-direction geometry, mass and time records must agree, with tool and specimen IDs. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「將滑移造成的速度差當成材料流失」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Mistaking slip-induced speed differences for material loss rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 將滑移造成的速度差當成材料流失；不能直接等同塑性應變、強度提升或材料收得。
steps.failureEn: Mistaking slip-induced speed differences for material loss; It is not identical to plastic strain, strength gain or material yield.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「不能直接等同塑性應變、強度提升或材料收得。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state It is not identical to plastic strain, strength gain or material yield.

steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 0.5 mm/s. Slip, accumulation, density changes and bypasses require extra terms.
steps.failure: 將滑移造成的速度差當成材料流失；有滑移、蓄積、密度變化或旁路時需補上額外支流。
steps.failureEn: Mistaking slip-induced speed differences for material loss; Slip, accumulation, density changes and bypasses require extra terms.
steps.check: 原值重算與 5 mm/s 相符；10%案例與 5.5 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 5 mm/s at baseline and 5.5 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（mm/s）？
quiz.explanation: 按 inarea*inspeed/outarea 逐項代入，結果為 5；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into inarea*inspeed/outarea gives 5; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元2｜截面與速度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Area-speed continuity: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「銅材連續擠製的入口質量與出口截面」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Feed mass and exit section in continuous copper extrusion with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「銅材連續擠製的入口質量與出口截面」設計「截面與速度」的獨立驗證：以獨立長度與時間量測兩端速度，避免使用同一馬達轉速推導兩端。 三方向幾何、進出質量及時間資料須互相一致，保留工具和試片編號。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Feed mass and exit section in continuous copper extrusion, independently verify Area-speed continuity: Measure lengths and times independently at both ends instead of deriving both speeds from one motor. Three-direction geometry, mass and time records must agree, with tool and specimen IDs. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「將滑移造成的速度差當成材料流失」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Mistaking slip-induced speed differences for material loss rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 將滑移造成的速度差當成材料流失；有滑移、蓄積、密度變化或旁路時需補上額外支流。
steps.failureEn: Mistaking slip-induced speed differences for material loss; Slip, accumulation, density changes and bypasses require extra terms.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「有滑移、蓄積、密度變化或旁路時需補上額外支流。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Slip, accumulation, density changes and bypasses require extra terms.

steps.title: 單元2｜截面與速度：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Area-speed continuity: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「銅材連續擠製的入口質量與出口截面」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Feed mass and exit section in continuous copper extrusion with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「將滑移造成的速度差當成材料流失」。以本單元「截面與速度」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「以獨立長度與時間量測兩端速度，避免使用同一馬達轉速推導兩端。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Mistaking slip-induced speed differences for material loss. For Area-speed continuity, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Measure lengths and times independently at both ends instead of deriving both speeds from one motor. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「將滑移造成的速度差當成材料流失」不是單靠 5 mm/s 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 5 mm/s alone cannot exclude Mistaking slip-induced speed differences for material loss; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 將滑移造成的速度差當成材料流失；有滑移、蓄積、密度變化或旁路時需補上額外支流。
steps.failureEn: Mistaking slip-induced speed differences for material loss; Slip, accumulation, density changes and bypasses require extra terms.
steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「銅材連續擠製的入口質量與出口截面」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Feed mass and exit section in continuous copper extrusion and retaining failed cases.
